Entries.Text: Renames the selected parts after their models, as the game names them: model_0000, model_0001 and so on. In Elden Ring and Nightreign the number is the part's InstanceID, from 9000 up, and in Armored Core VI the part gets a free TypeIndex. Parts already named this way keep their names. References follow the new names when Referenced Rename is on. Can be undone.
The selected parts are already named after their models.
